query: SELECT jsonb_build_object('work', jsonb_build_object('revision', w.metadata_revision, 'fields', w.metadata_field_revisions), 'manifestation', jsonb_build_object('revision', m.metadata_revision, 'fields', m.metadata_field_revisions)) AS "identity!" FROM manifestations m JOIN works w ON w.id = m.work_id WHERE m.id = $1
